translate_en|mods/Fishing Expansion/42/m: Fishing Expansion
Allow any knife to fillet fish
Off: vanilla sharp knives and meat cleavers only. On: allows all vanilla handheld knives, including butter and plastic knives.
Enable Rice Foraging
Turns the mod's Crops-category rice on or off.
Enable Specific Catch Selector
Adds a world right-click menu that lets you choose the exact Fishing Expansion fish or seafood item caught by your next successful fishing attempt. The selection clears after one catch.
Normal Foraging Density
100 is vanilla. Higher levels add more forage and may stutter.
Rice Foraging Intensity
Higher levels make rice appear more often and easier to detect.
Maximum Rice per Find
Maximum rice received from one forage find.
Minimum Rice per Find
Minimum rice received from one forage find.
Fishing Expansion
Allow any knife to fillet fish
Off: vanilla sharp knives and meat cleavers only. On: adds a filleting recipe for all vanilla handheld knives, including butter and plastic knives.
Enable extra rice foraging
When enabled, rice can be found using the Crops foraging focus. Vanilla's rare Junk Food/Trash rice remains controlled by the base game.
Enable Specific Catch Selector
Adds a world right-click menu that lets you choose the exact Fishing Expansion fish or seafood item caught by your next successful fishing attempt. The selection clears after one catch.
Forage density percent
Controls global forage density from 100 to 1,000 percent. 100 is vanilla and recommended for smooth performance. Extremely high values may cause serious stuttering.
Rice maximum count
Maximum rice found from one forage icon.
Rice minimum count
Minimum rice found from one forage icon.
Rice Foraging Intensity
Controls both how often rice appears and how easily it is detected. 100 is occasional, 500 is much more common, and 1,000 is very frequent.
Rice foraging chance
Legacy setting. Effective rice chance is capped at 15 and rice is crops-only.
Rice maximum count
Legacy setting. Maximum rice found from one forage icon.
Rice minimum count
Legacy setting. Minimum rice found from one forage icon.
Rice foraging visibility
Legacy setting. Controls how easy rice is to spot while foraging.
Seaweed foraging chance
Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Seaweed maximum count
Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Seaweed minimum count
Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
Seaweed foraging visibility
Legacy setting. Seaweed foraging has been disabled; seaweed is now caught from placed fishing nets only.
